rationale: Endorse as an advisory architecture and evidence plan. The exact candidate preserves permissionless supported-program deployment, mandatory objective correctness and signed authority, and the required Midnight ZKIRv3 terminal artifact. It separates host jet equivalence, adversarial-witness constraint soundness, valid-input completeness, producer obligations, and compiler-route trusted bases. Typed liability evolution, full effect framing, and signed phase-specific failure policies resolve important ambiguities without asserting implementation. A0/A1 remain advisory and cannot displace the principal source-to-ledger proof path.
caveats: This verdict is not product acceptance or approval of the current documentation diff. The separate documentation-review.md identifies unresolved concrete reconciliation issues; endorsement of this architecture does not close them.

I independently audited local Simplicity, prior Moriarty jet notes and relevant ZKIRv3 code in jet-zkirv3-audit.md. I did not independently reproduce the PR17 Agda proof or inspect every WShape/SubRealizer lemma; the candidate treats their assumptions as obligations rather than established Moriarty assurance.
The proposed instruction mapping needs an actual version-pinned artifact and per-constructor range/guard/rejection/work proof; old instruction names alone do not transfer proofs.
History recursion, authenticated complete effects, privacy, backend feasibility, deployed phase behavior and runnable certificate checking remain unimplemented or unestablished in this review.
The candidate is direction for general compositions within a defined supported language, not a claim that every conceivable DeFi program or natural-language wish can be compiled or proved.
evidence_that_would_change_vote: A public compile/prove/deploy path that requires maintainer or reviewer admission, or an optional managed router becoming mandatory.
An accepted witness that violates the frozen Core judgment or signed intent because WShape, range, overflow, guards, openings or effect framing are unenforced.
A jet or lowerer changing rejection, logical work, residual liability, authorization consumption or permitted charged-failure outcomes without an explicit semantic-profile and signed-policy change.
Evidence that the required Midnight target cannot support the committed correctness/history statement within stated bounds, requiring architectural revision rather than a silent relaxation.
A deployment or documentation claim promoting hashes, finite tests, honest witness generation, conditional upstream theorems or Core-only advisory discharge into established end-to-end proof.
